uncited: **Compositing:** Perform numeric integration along the viewing rays on the resampled slices.
**Warping:** Transform the intermediate image of the compositing stage into the final image.

*   **Spatial Domain Zero-Padding:** If spatial domain zero-padding is too small in shear-based methods, data passes over the border and re-enters from the other side due to periodicity, an error amplified by consecutive shears.
*   **Rounding Error:** Zero-padding can only be applied in discrete steps, so $K_0$ is rounded to the closest integer.
